verdict.rationale: WezTerm ships an official, documented `wezterm cli` subcommand that drives a running GUI or mux instance to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes. A runtime probe confirmed a fully headless agent loop (mux-server daemonize, spawn, send-text, get-text, list), and a community user independently relies on `get-text` to dump scrollback. Missing for 10: evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output modes and in-depth per-subcommand reference beyond the overview snippets.
